function.name: write
function.arguments:
{"path": "plot_success_rates.py", "content": "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Define noise levels in order
noise_levels = ['Low', 'Medium', 'High']
noise_order = {'Low': 0, 'Medium': 1, 'High': 2}

# Define policies and colors
policies = ['BC', 'GAIL', 'IRL', 'Ours']
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#96CEB4']
linestyles = ['solid', 'dashed', 'dotted', 'solid']

# Create the figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Plot each policy
for i, policy in enumerate(policies):
    policy_data = df[df['policy'] == policy].sort_values('noise_level', key=lambda x: x.map(noise_order))
    success_rates = policy_data['success_rate'].values
    
    ax.plot(noise_levels, success_rates, 
            marker='o', 
            markersize=10, 
            linewidth=2.5, 
            markersize=12,
            markerfacecolor='white',
            markeredgecolor=colors[i],
            markeredgewidth=2,
            color=colors[i],
            linestyle=linestyles[i],
            label=f'{policy}',
            zorder=3)
    
    # Add value annotations
    for j, (noise, rate) in enumerate(zip(noise_levels, success_rates)):
        ax.annotate(f'{rate}%', 
                   (noise_levels[j], rate),
                   textcoords="offset points",
                   xytext=(0, 10),
                   ha='center',
                   fontsize=10,
                   fontweight='bold')

# Customize the plot
ax.set_xlabel('Environment Noise Level', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Robotic Manipulation Policy Performance\nUnder Varying Environment Noise', 
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

ax.set_ylim(30, 95)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 2.5)

# Add grid
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add legend with better positioning
legend = ax.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=11, framealpha=0.95)
legend.get_frame().set_edgecolor('gray')

# Highlight the "Ours" method
ax.axhline(y=70, color='gray', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='70% threshold')

# Add text annotation about the key insight
ax.text(0.02, 0.98, 
        'Key Finding: Our method maintains >70% success rate\n'
        'even under high noise, while baselines degrade sharply',
        transform=ax.transAxes,
        fontsize=10,
        verticalalignment='top',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.8))

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('success_rates.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
print("Visualization saved to success_rates.png")

# Also print summary statistics
print("\nSuccess Rate Degradation from Low to High Noise:")
for policy in policies:
    low_rate = df[(df['policy'] == policy) & (df['noise_level'] == 'Low')]['success_rate'].values[0]
    high_rate = df[(df['policy'] == policy) & (df['noise_level'] == 'High')]['success_rate'].values[0]
    degradation = low_rate - high_rate
    print(f"  {policy}: {low_rate}% → {high_rate}% (degradation: {degradation:.1f}%)")"}
